text:
ana_csm: Kicking off onboarding for ArcadiaRx — first-engage implementation roadmap. Owners: Ana (CSM), Liam (SE), Nora (PM), Devon (Eng). High-level goals: ingest sample data, validate privacy paths, and run pilot workflows by end of Q2. Quick sync on stakeholders, success criteria, and timelines?

liam_se: +1. Can we confirm their data engineer contact and whether they need a VPC/private deploy?

arcadia_it: hi all — I'm Sam (Arcadia IT). We need VPC due to PHI. Sam@arcadia.com. Target pilot by 2026-06-30.

nora_pm: Thanks Sam — noted VPC. I'll update the timeline. Major milestones I'm thinking: 1) Access & infra signoff (2w), 2) Integration + test data (3w), 3) Pilot prep + enablement (2w), 4) Pilot run (2w). Any objections?

devon_eng: Looks reasonable. Risk: model quantization choices may affect latency for their low-latency triage use-case. We'll propose a perf baseline and a quantization plan.

ana_csm: Success criteria (proposed):
- Inbound integration ingesting 95% of sample payloads
- Latency <= 500ms p50 for triage flow
- No PII leakage in logs / audit gating confirmed
- Stakeholder signoff on pilot results

maria-successops: Suggest adding enablement checkpoints: product training for Ops (1hr), SE tech walkthrough (2hrs), and a go/no-go review. I'll own scheduling.

liam_se: Can someone share the minimal required access? I can put together an access matrix.

ana_csm: Here's the minimal list:
```
- Read-only access to sample S3 bucket or secure file share
- API key for sandbox with rate limit caps
- VPC peering details + CIDR allowlist
- Point of contact for troubleshooting (on-call email)
```

arcadia_it: We can provide S3 read-only and API key. VPC peering request needs our networking ticket (I'll open it today).

nora_pm: Timeline draft (starts next Monday):
- Week 1: infra request + access granted
- Weeks 2-4: integration and ingestion tests
- Week 5: enablement + pilot prep
- Weeks 6-7: pilot execution + measurement
- Week 8: pilot review + decision

liam_se: I'll schedule a 30m tech kickoff Wed 10am PT. Agenda: access, sample payloads, dev sandboxes, perf baseline.

devon_eng: Flagging a renewal risk: procurement mentioned contract renewal at 6 months. If pilot slips >4w we risk downstream budget cycles. Recommend we keep firm dates and an internal mitigation plan (canary runs, fallbacks to hosted).

ana_csm: Good call. I'll add renewal-risk review to the pilot review agenda and propose a contingency: if pilot delayed, offer a short paid POC extension for visibility.

maria-successops: Enablement assets I'll prepare: quickstart (15min), runbook, and monitoring dashboard template. Will post links in this thread when ready.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: sandbox-provisioner -> 2026-04-07T02:00:00Z (info only) :rocket:

arcadia_it: Networking ticket created: NT-4589. ETA for peering: 5 business days.

liam_se: Noted. If peering slips, we can demo via secure S3 + API key as interim.

nora_pm: Action items summary:
- Ana: coordinate pilot review + renewal-risk item
- Liam: access matrix + tech kickoff invite (Wed 10am PT)
- Devon: perf baseline doc and quant plan
- Maria: enablement assets + scheduling
- Sam (Arcadia): confirm ETA for peering + provide sample payloads

ana_csm: Thanks everyone — I'll update the project roadmap and share a calendar invite for the weekly 30m sync. Please react with :thumbsup: when you've added your items.

arcadia_it: :thumbsup:

liam_se: :thumbsup:

devon_eng: :thumbsup:

maria-successops: :thumbsup:

ana_csm: Closing note: capturing feedback loop — we'll run two short feedback forms during pilot (after week 1 and end of pilot) to capture usability and regression signals. Adds: who from Arcadia should we include for feedback?

arcadia_it: Sam + Dr. Patel (clinical lead). I'll loop them in.

nora_pm: Great — I'll include them on the pilot review invite.

liam_se: all set on my side. See you on Wed.

ana_csm: End of thread — will post updated roadmap and links.
